messages:
karin: Quick note — starting a micro access sweep for admin IAM bindings + unlabeled KMS keys in prod tomorrow. Proposed flow: 72h self-attest, label `temp:quarantine` + disable console/API after 72h, 30d snapshot then escalate to archival if no owner. Please ack and volunteer owners.

pete: ack. Can we prefer rotate+rekey over destruction for keys? For keys used by services we should create a proxy SA and rotate creds before any disable.

rhea: +1. I'll run a fast scan tonight and upload CSV. Commands i use: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner"))'` and `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format='csv(name,labels)'`.

attest-bot: attestation:start ts=3312345678 scope=org module=ownerless_quickscan

rhea: uploaded -> gs://redwood-security/quickscans/3312345678-orphans.csv (5 rows). samples: svcacct-ml-cache@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com,owner=null; key-billing-legacy,labels=null

karin: assigned owners in sheet: svcacct-ml-cache -> @pete, key-billing-legacy -> @rhea. I'll draft the self-attest email and include a link to the form + timeline. tagging @legal for retention language.

legal: retention check — infra-only keys: 180d snapshot retention is fine. Keys touching customer data require 2yr retention and exec signoff. Keep archive proof in gs://redwood-security/archives/3312345678/.

pete: i'll add a terraform gating note to block new `roles/owner` PRs unless `infra/owners.yaml` has an entry and CODEOWNERS approved. Also will add a small playbook for proxy SA creation.

attest-bot: attestation:complete ts=3312345788 status=partial_orphans=5 report=gs://redwood-security/quickscans/3312345678-report.json

karin: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) @pete infra PR for gating (2) @rhea remediation steps + proof-of-rotation template (3) I'll schedule a 20-min sync if >7 orphans next sweep.
